recruit_text.backstory: Réka made stop-motion films in Budapest, moving puppets one frame at a time until they looked alive. She'd done it for twelve years when the worlds joined, and it turned out to be the best training for necromancy anyone's ever had. She's sly, funny and very precise, and she treats the dead the way she treated her puppets, with patience and a lot of small adjustments.
recruit_text.forward:
To make something move that's never moved before, and she's careful not to say what.

She's also looking for a good camera. She knows there isn't one, and she keeps looking anyway.

stages.stranger: I'm Réka, a necromancer, and that's my crow. Don't stare at it, it's shy. It was shy before it died, too.
stages.acquaintance: I'm from Pécs, in Hungary, but I lived in Budapest, in the eighth district, in a studio above a bakery. I made stop-motion films for twelve years, moving puppets a millimetre at a time. One of them won a prize at Annecy. Necromancy's much the same, if you ask me. It's all weight and timing and follow-through.
stages.companion: I was moving a puppet's arm when it happened, and I landed in the Dry Deep with this little wooden mannequin in my hand. I had a cat, Kocka, who hated every puppet I ever made. I miss her more than I'd admit to anyone. And my mother's a teacher in Pécs. I haven't found her.
stages.friend: My father was a puppeteer. He ran a little puppet theatre, and I grew up backstage watching him bring wooden things to life. He died when I was nineteen, and I started making films because it was the closest thing to what he did. Here's my secret, na. I want to make a moving picture for the children on the Black Strand. There's no camera. I'll need your help.
stages.sworn: I showed it on the Black Strand, by lantern, to every child I could find. The little puppet flapped its wings and flew, and they screamed. It's the first thing I've made move here without anything dying first. I cried, which was embarrassing, and they made me show it forty times. I'm drawing a longer one now. I gave the mannequin its wire back. My father would have liked it.

moments.prompt: Her skeletal crow hops onto your shoulder and stares at you.

options.text: Hold very still and let it.
options.reply: Ha, it likes you, and that's rare. Most people scream.
Hey, that's rude. It took me a week to teach it to hop like that.

moments.prompt: She's asked you to help her build a zoetrope for the children.

options.reply: Jó, that's good. I'll need glass, a gear and black lacquer, and all of them are somewhere horrible.
Because that's the point. I want it to move without dying first.

lines.bored_warning: I'm bored stiff, and so is my crow. Anywhere else would do.
lines.leaving_good: What a lovely trip. I'm off to the Black Strand to draw some of it.
lines.leaving_bored: Same thing every day, and I can't stand it. I'll be on the Black Strand with my crow.
lines.after_wipe: Well, that went badly for everybody. Let's get up and try it again.
lines.wipe_warning: My crow's started hiding whenever we die, and I don't blame it. I'll finish this run, but I need a few days off after.
lines.wipe_leave: That's over, thank goodness. I'll be on the Black Strand for a while, drawing something cheerful.
lines.zone_warning: Even my crow's nervous, and it's already dead. Let's go back.
lines.zone_leave: Even my crow said no, and it never says no. I'll be on the Black Strand.
lines.gear_refuse: Na, that's mine. Give me a few more weeks of you first.
lines.gear_taken: Go on, then. I'll be fine without it.
lines.gear_short: That missing piece is starting to annoy me, just so you know.
lines.gear_upgrade: Oh, that's gorgeous. Köszönöm, thank you.
lines.back: My crow's learned a new hop! Shall I show you on the way?
lines.send_word: Réka has sent word from the Black Strand. Her crow's restless and so is she.
lines.walkout_talk: I stormed off, and I'd like to explain properly. After that you get your turn.
lines.neglect: Finally, you're back! My crow kept looking for you, and so did I.
lines.asked_to_stay: Jó, one more. Then I sketch.
lines.on_break: Réka is back on the Black Strand with her crow. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.

boss_down.text: Did you see how it fell? I'd love to draw that.

dungeon_clear.text: My feet hurt and there's spider web in my hair. Can we eat now?

town_arrive.text: I lived above a bakery in Budapest, so I woke up hungry every morning for twelve years. Is there a bakery here?

zone_arrive.text: Plenty of bones out here. My crow wants friends.
